title: Uruguayan Lamb Pilaf
description: A hearty, flavorful Uruguayan-inspired pilaf that's perfect for a post-workout meal, made with tender lamb and sweet blueberries.

ingredients.name: lamb shoulder or neck, cut into 2-inch pieces
short-grain rice
ingredients.notes: such as Calrose or Japanese rice

ingredients.name: olive oil
ingredients.notes: for cooking the onions and rice

instructions: In a large Dutch oven or oven-safe pot, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the diced onions and cook until they're lightly browned, stirring occasionally.
Add the lamb pieces to the pot and cook until they're browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the water to the pot, then cover it with a lid.
Transfer the pot to the preheated oven and braise the lamb for 1 1/2 hours, or until it's tender.
While the lamb is braising, cook the rice according to package instructions.
Once the lamb is done, remove it from the pot and set it aside.
Add the cooked rice to the pot and stir to combine with the braising liquid.
Stir in the chopped parsley, mint, and blueberries.
Season the pilaf with salt, black pepper, cumin, and paprika to taste.
Serve the pilaf hot, garnished with additional parsley and blueberries if desired.
Slice or shred the braised lamb and serve it on top of the pilaf.
